# Step - id

`id` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Yields the id of each vertex or edge (a string).

## Forms

```text
id()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has("name", "josh").id().to_list()   // ["4"]
```
